objective: production-grade long-only intraday US equity strategies derived from the full eligible market universe

research_universe.ranking_scope: all point-in-time eligible symbols are ranked jointly for every session and decision clock
research_universe.action_scope: ordinary US equities selected from the eligible full-market cross-section; a fixed TQQQ/SOXL or other small hard-coded action universe is forbidden
research_universe.membership: point-in-time observed tradability only; unavailable symbols are ineligible rather than imputed
research_universe.survivorship_rule: current constituents must not be projected backward and delisted symbols must not be silently excluded
research_universe.data_gaps: fail closed; no zero-fill, forward-fill, cross-provider minute splicing, or missing-as-cash performance

hard_gates.execution_parity: exact production signal, exposure, sizing, timing, and exit evaluator must reproduce frozen research decisions
